qualifier: heparan and chondroitin/dermatan chains with skeletal dysplasia defects
name: Heparan and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan synthesis and skeletal dysplasias
rationale: All members concern biosynthesis of heparan, heparin, chondroitin and dermatan sulfate proteoglycan chains or inherited defects in it (EXT1/2 exostoses, SLC26A2 and SLC35D1 chondrodysplasias), unlike the degradation/mucopolysaccharidosis confusable and the broader glycosylation confusables with keratan, O-glycan and linkage-region pathways.

qualifier: intracellular domain release to the nucleus, not target transcription
name: Notch receptor proteolytic activation and intracellular domain release
rationale: All members describe proteolytic processing of NOTCH1-4 (including constitutively cleaved NOTCH1 mutants and intramembrane proteolysis) that releases the intracellular domain to the nucleus, whereas confusables centre on NICD-driven transcription, PEST/FBXW7 turnover or ERBB4 signaling.

core: Neural tube dorsoventral patterning and neuron specification
qualifier: spinal cord motor neurons/interneurons and hindbrain-brainstem
name: Spinal cord and brainstem neuron patterning and specification
rationale: Members cover dorsoventral neural tube patterning, motor neuron and interneuron fate specification in spinal cord and hindbrain, and brainstem development including respiratory control, distinguishing them from floor plate/neural plate, pons maturation and midbrain dopaminergic confusables.

qualifier: negative feedback and phosphatase-mediated switch-off, including escape by MAPK mutants
name: Negative feedback inactivation of ERK MAP kinases
rationale: All three members concern switching off ERK1/2 through negative feedback and dephosphorylation, including ERK mutants that evade it, unlike confusables on Ras/ERK cascade regulation, p38/JNK activation, ERK5 or AP-1 output.

qualifier: erythroid and megakaryocytic branch
name: Erythroid and megakaryocytic lineage differentiation
rationale: Members describe erythrocyte and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation, RUNX1 regulation, oxygen transport and erythroid/megakaryocyte expression modules (one TAK1-ATF module is an outlier), distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on myeloid, granulocytic and stem cell programmes.

qualifier: at early and late endosome membranes
name: Endosomal phosphoinositide synthesis and dephosphorylation
rationale: All members concern synthesis and dephosphorylation of phosphatidylinositol phosphates on endosomal membranes, unlike confusables on Golgi/endosome traffic, autophagy, or PIP synthesis at the Golgi and plasma membrane.

name: Serotonin receptor signaling
rationale: All members are 5-HT receptor signaling routes (Gs, Gi, Gq-PLC and ionotropic 5-HT3), whereas confusables cover serotonin synthesis and uptake, muscarinic or histamine receptors, and gut motility.

qualifier: respiratory burst, degranulation and bacterial/fungal killing
name: Phagocyte respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members concern neutrophil/myeloid activation, NADPH-oxidase respiratory burst, degranulation and killing of bacteria and yeast, distinguishing them from anti-inflammatory macrophage, monocyte marker, formyl-peptide chemotaxis and Fc-receptor confusables.

qualifier: in osmosensing and cell volume responses
name: Osmosensing and sodium/potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members regulate Na+, K+ and Cl- transport (including renal and transepithelial) alongside hypo- and hyperosmotic responses, separating the theme from potassium channel/cotransporter-defect and aldosterone confusables (no osmosensing) and from a salt-stress confusable lacking Na+/K+ transport regulation.

qualifier: GABA and glycine
name: GABA and glycine neurotransmitter metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover GABA synthesis, degradation, secretion and reuptake plus glycinergic transmission and the glycine transporter defect, distinguishing them from glutamate/aspartate transport and cholinergic confusables.

qualifier: Cdc20/Cdh1-targeted degradation of mitotic cyclins, securin and Nek2A
name: APC/C regulation and mitotic cyclin and securin degradation
rationale: All members concern APC/C activity (phosphorylation, inhibition, ligase activation) and its degradation of mitotic substrates during anaphase and mitotic exit, unlike confusables on metaphase-anaphase transition, Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switching or Emi1 control.

core: Germline and stem cell specification and maintenance
qualifier: primordial germ cells and preimplantation lineages
name: Germline and early embryonic lineage specification
rationale: Members cover primordial germ cell specification, migration and survival, germline stem cell maintenance and inner cell mass/trophectoderm differentiation, distinguishing them from oocyte maturation, testis somatic cell and trophoblast/decidua confusables.

qualifier: lactose and dietary disaccharide digestion, galactosemias
name: Galactose, lactose and dietary disaccharide metabolism
rationale: Members concern Leloir galactose catabolism and its galactosemia defects, lactose synthesis, galactose transport and disaccharide digestion, distinguishing them from fructose, pentose and hexose-transport confusables.

qualifier: epithelial-mesenchymal transition and collagen/TGF-beta modules
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal transition and extracellular matrix gene program
rationale: Members are EMT, collagen/TGF-beta, ECM and mechanoresponsive fibroblast modules with focal adhesion assembly, whereas confusables emphasize fibronectin/integrin interactions, migration or resident stromal fibroblast signatures without the EMT program.

qualifier: negative feedback on glucocorticoid signaling and steroid secretion
name: Glucocorticoid response and its negative feedback
rationale: Members concern cellular responses to cortisol and dexamethasone and the restraint of glucocorticoid signaling and steroid secretion, whereas confusables cover HPA-axis stimulation of corticotropin and glucocorticoid secretion or circadian/metabolic control.

qualifier: CFTR-dependent
name: CFTR-dependent epithelial anion and fluid secretion
rationale: Most members concern CFTR-mediated anion and water transport in secretory epithelia (cystic fibrosis, CFTR trafficking, saliva and pancreatic secretion, enterotoxin diarrhoea), with itch and prolactin secretion as outliers, distinguishing the theme from TRP/pH-sensing channels and apical/basolateral protein sorting confusables.

qualifier: primary cilium cargo targeting and centriole elongation
name: Primary cilium assembly, disassembly and intraflagellar cargo transport
rationale: Members cover ciliogenesis, intraflagellar transport, ciliary membrane cargo targeting, basal body anchoring and centriole elongation, distinguishing them from photoreceptor, motile multiciliated and centrosome-organization confusables.

qualifier: single-strand annealing, microhomology-mediated end joining and BRCA2-RAD51 presynaptic loading
name: Double-strand break end resection and resection-dependent repair
rationale: All members concern 5' end resection of DNA breaks and the repair routes that follow it (SSA, alt-NHEJ, RAD51 presynaptic filament loading via BRCA2/PALB2), unlike confusables on D-loop resolution, BRCA1 defects, classical NHEJ or break sensing.

qualifier: naive, memory, germinal centre and plasma cell stages
name: B cell identity and germinal centre differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell, naive/memory/plasma cell signatures and regulation of germinal centre, Tfh and plasma cell differentiation, distinguishing them from confusables centred on CD27, BCR signaling, B-1 cells and B cell proliferation.

qualifier: via Rap1, integrin adaptors and oncogenic RAF/RAS mutants
name: RAF-MAPK activation via Rap1, integrins and oncogenic RAF
rationale: Members describe RAF-MEK-ERK activation by BRAF/RAF1 mutants and fusions, RAS mutants, Rap1 and integrin-linked GRB2:SOS/p130Cas complexes, distinguishing them from MRAS/SHOC2, negative-feedback and RAS-GAP confusables.

core: Membrane coat dynamics and organelle tethering
qualifier: clathrin coat cycling plus Miro GTPase and organelle membrane docking
name: Clathrin coat cycling, vesicle endocytosis and organelle membrane tethering
rationale: Members combine clathrin coat assembly/disassembly and synaptic vesicle endocytosis with membrane docking and tethering events (Miro GTPase cycles, mitochondria-ER tethering, autophagosome docking, membrane repair, annular gap junctions), the latter absent from all synaptic confusables.

qualifier: nuclear lamina disassembly and early reformation
name: Mitotic nuclear lamina and envelope breakdown and reformation
rationale: Members concern mitotic nuclear membrane disassembly, lamina depolymerization and initiation of envelope reformation, distinguishing them from ESCRT-III sealing/cytokinesis and nuclear pore complex confusables.

qualifier: LTP/LTD, postsynaptic calcium, spine morphogenesis and synapse maturation
name: Bidirectional synaptic plasticity, spine morphogenesis and short-term memory
rationale: Members promote long-term potentiation and depression, dendritic spine and synapse maturation, postsynaptic calcium and short-term memory, unlike confusables on reelin/spine maintenance, amyloid-beta, synaptic translation or CREB nuclear signaling.

qualifier: core clock feedback loop together with MECP2 regulation
name: Circadian clock feedback loop and MECP2 neuronal transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER clock loop and MECP2, HDAC, CREB and NPAS4 activity-dependent neuronal transcription, a combination that separates the theme from MECP2-only, circadian-output-only and cAMP/PKA confusables.

core: Matrix signaling at the plasma membrane
qualifier: collagen/TGF-beta driven focal adhesion assembly
name: Collagen and TGF-beta matrix signaling promoting focal adhesion assembly
rationale: The three members link a collagen/TGF-beta module, plasma-membrane signal transduction and focal adhesion assembly, whereas confusables centre on fibronectin, integrin and syndecan interactions, Rho effectors or MET-PTK2 signaling.
